Calculate ULM / MLM activity scores per cell

lm_activity_sc.Rd

Rust implementation of decoupler's univariate (ULM) and multivariate (MLM) linear model activity scores, per cell (or meta cell) on the normalised counts. See calc_lm_activity() for the model. Cells are read and scored in chunks, so memory stays bounded on large data.

Differences to decoupler and things to know:

  • Every gene of the store enters the model, including genes that are zero in every cell. decoupler drops those, so scores differ slightly where targets were never detected.

  • Empty cells score 0 with a p-value of 1.

  • MLM errors on collinear sources.

  • The p-values treat genes as independent, which they are not in a single cell. Read them as descriptive.

Usage

lm_activity_sc(object, net, lm_params = params_lm_activity(), .verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

object

SingleCells or MetaCells class.

net

data.frame. The network in long format with the columns source, target and optionally weight. Targets need to be gene identifiers of the object.

lm_params

List. The parameters, see params_lm_activity().

.verbose

Boolean or integer. Controls verbosity and returns run times. FALSE -> quiet, TRUE or 1L -> normal verbosity, 2L -> detailed verbosity.

Value

For SingleCells, an ScMatrixRes of cells x sources with the activities if p_values = FALSE. Otherwise a list with the ScMatrixRes elements es, pvals and fdr (BH per cell across sources). For MetaCells the same, but plain matrices of meta cells x sources. NULL with a warning if no source has at least tmin targets in the object.

References

Badia-i-Mompel, et al., Bioinform. Adv., 2022

Examples

# score two made-up regulons on the demo data
sc <- demo_single_cells()
genes <- get_gene_names(sc)
net <- data.frame(
  source = rep(c("tf_a", "tf_b"), each = 10L),
  target = genes[1:20],
  weight = 1
)
res <- lm_activity_sc(sc, net = net, .verbose = FALSE)
dim(res)
#> [1] 500   2

unlink(sc@dir_data, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
